gloss: public road; local road; ordinary road

definitions.gloss: public road; local road; ordinary road
definitions.explanation: A regular road as opposed to an expressway or highway. In Japan, this refers to toll-free roads with intersections and traffic lights, as distinct from toll expressways.

examples.japanese: {一般道|いっぱんどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: To drive on a local road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高速|こうそく}→高速：02749_kousoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わ→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ず{一般道|いっぱんどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went by local roads without using the expressway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{降|お}りて→降りる：00568_oriru⟧{一般道|いっぱんどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}えた→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧。
examples.english: To avoid the traffic jam, I exited the expressway and switched to local roads.

notes:
{一般道|いっぱんどう} is the common short form of {一般道路|いっぱんどうろ}. It refers to ordinary, toll-free roads with intersections and traffic lights.

FORMS:
⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧ (general, ordinary) + {道|どう} (road).

SIMILAR WORDS:
The key distinction is with ⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧ (expressway / toll road). In Japan, expressways charge tolls and have no traffic lights, while {一般道|いっぱんどう} is free and has normal intersections.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一般道|いっぱんどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to drive on local roads
- {一般道|いっぱんどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧: to exit onto local roads
- {一般道|いっぱんどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制限速度|せいげんそくど}→制限速度：26875_seigensokudo⟧: speed limit on local roads

USAGE:
Very common in navigation systems (カーナビ), traffic reports, and driving conversations. The typical speed limit on {一般道|いっぱんどう} in Japan is 60 km/h in urban areas and 60 km/h outside cities unless otherwise posted.
